# Lint Forge

> Desktop Biome rule review app for generating custom biome.json lint configurations.

Lint Forge helps developers import an existing Biome config, skip explicitly configured rules, review the remaining linter rules in a focused deck, and export a generated biome.json.

## Links

- [Live app](https://lint-forge.marlonpassos.com.br/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/MarlonPassos-git/lint-forge)
- [Biome documentation](https://biomejs.dev/)

## Topics

Biome, lint rules, biome.json, React, Vite, TypeScript, developer tools.
